name: Lisboa
author: 0rokska8
description:
**Lisboa Metropolitan Area (AML) — 18 municipalities, 2.87M inhabitants.**

*(Vibecoded with Claude, and shamelessly inspired by [bquelhas's Porto map](https://github.com/bquelhas/subwaybuilder-map-opo) — the AMP map came first and showed what a Portuguese pipeline should look like: INE BGRI21 for residents, COS for jobs, a captive multiplier per municipality. Thank you.)*

**Demand Model**

* 103,831 O/D pairs from INE BGRI 2021 (census subsection level)
* 1.90M simulated passengers — 66.3% population coverage, 2.23M including special demand
* Commuters between every pair of municipalities fitted to the Censos 2021 counts (661,391 people; Lisboa↔Sintra is the heaviest at 60,207) — and 149k crossing the Tejo, as INE counts them
* Jobs placed by DGT COS2025 (Série 2) land cover over 884k Overture building footprints — the Série 2 legend separates housing from workplaces, so employment stays off the bedrooms
* Realistic urban drive-times (distance buckets + density penalty)
* Captive boost for low car-ownership areas (Lisboa ×1.9, Amadora ×1.45, Odivelas ×1.35, Almada ×1.3)

**The Tejo**

* Nine of the eighteen municipalities are on the south bank
* Cacilhas to Cais do Sodré is 2 km in a straight line and 7.5 km by road
* Cross-river trips are routed via the 25 de Abril or the Vasco da Gama and charged an 8-minute queueing penalty, so a river crossing is worth building without being the only thing worth building

**Points of Interest**

* 82 curated points, each anchored to a named OpenStreetMap feature
* Humberto Delgado Airport, Port of Lisboa, cruise terminal, Lisnave, Autoeuropa
* Hospitals (Santa Maria, São José, Garcia de Orta, Amadora-Sintra, Fernando Fonseca) and universities (Cidade Universitária, IST, NOVA, ISCTE, Católica)
* Staff, daily attendance and visitors are counted separately, so a shopping centre doesn't out-employ a business district

**Coverage**

* Full detail to zoom 15 across the AML, 6,230 km²
* Railway station buildings removed from the collision set — you shouldn't have to buy and bulldoze Gare do Oriente to run a train into it
data_source: INE BGRI21 + INE Censos 2021 commuting table (0012340) + DGT COS2025 + OpenStreetMap + Overture
